units.source_text: 刚把话说完，我顿觉心脏在激烈地跳动。

en.t: No sooner had I finished saying those words than I suddenly felt my heart pounding violently.

units.source_text: 鞠子却笑了起来，笑得乳房也晃动了。

en.t: Mariko, however, began to laugh, laughing so hard that even her breasts shook.

units.source_text: 她隐约地望着我，咬着和服袖，强忍住了笑。

en.t: She gazed vaguely at me, biting the sleeve of her kimono as she struggled to hold back her laughter.

units.source_text: 可是，新的笑又涌了上来，她笑得前仰后合、全身震颤起来。

en.t: But another wave of laughter welled up, and she doubled over with it, her whole body trembling.
What could have been so funny?

units.source_text: 毫无疑问，鞠子也无法说清楚。

en.t: Without a doubt, Mariko herself could not have explained it clearly either.

units.source_text: 她觉察到这一点，就止住了笑。

en.t: When she realized that, she stopped laughing.
